name: What compensation can I seek in a birth injury lawsuit?

mainEntity.name: What compensation can I seek in a birth injury lawsuit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compensation in a birth injury lawsuit aims to cover the extensive costs associated with your child's injury. This can include past and future medical expenses, rehabilitation costs, therapy, special education needs, lost earning capacity for the child, pain and suffering, and emotional distress for both the child and parents. The specific damages sought depend on the unique circumstances and long-term impact of the injury on your child's life.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can seek compensation for medical expenses, therapy, special education, lost earning capacity, and pain and suffering related to the birth injury.
